name: CMMC 2.0 Level 2
description: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification 2.0 — DoD program to protect sensitive information in the defense industrial base supply chain. Level 2 aligns with NIST SP 800-171 for CUI.

controls.title: Authorized Access Control
controls.description: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices.

controls.title: CUI Flow Control
controls.description: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

controls.title: Non-Privileged Account Use
controls.description: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing non-security functions.

controls.title: Role-Based Risk Awareness
controls.description: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users are aware of the security risks associated with their activities.

controls.title: Role-Based Training
controls.description: Ensure that organizational personnel are adequately trained to carry out their assigned information security responsibilities.

controls.title: System Auditing
controls.description: Create and retain system audit logs to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.title: User Accountability
controls.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be traced to those users.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems.

controls.title: Security Configuration Enforcement
controls.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for IT products employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Multi-factor Authentication
controls.description: Use multi-factor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Maintenance
controls.description: Require MFA to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.

controls.title: Media Protection
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

controls.title: Personnel Sanctions
controls.description: Ensure that CUI is protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

controls.title: Limit Physical Access
controls.description: Limit physical access to organizational systems to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Periodically assess risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.
